div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
触发：AnalysisScheduler 周期任务
（15/30/60/120 分钟）或控制台「立即分析」
或会话详情页「立即分析本会话」
inputData KEY_FORCE_CONVERSATION

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
enabled 开关关闭
或当前预设槽位 URL 为空？

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
直接 Result.success()
不产生任何网络请求

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
遍历重点关注会话
WatchlistStore v3：空名单 = 默认不关注
SENTINEL_ALL = 全部关注
每会话取最近 ≤10 条组成 case 窗口
单轮 ≤ MAX_CONVERSATIONS_PER_ROUND=10 · 间隔 500ms

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
caseId 已存在于
analysis.jsonl？
（强制分析单会话时跳过）

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 跳过，不重复分析

div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ForkPrefilter.evaluate(kase)
初始 prob=1.0，乘性惩罚：
· 窗口 <2 条 → ×0.3
· 垃圾占比 ≥80% → ×0.05
· 垃圾占比 ≥50% → ×0.3
· 全窗口无文字 → min(prob, 0.02)
垃圾 = 系统提示语 / 纯表情标签 / 广告链接

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
prob < SHARP_THRESHOLD
= 0.15 ?

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
就地结案 filteredRecord()
filtered=true · protocol=prefilter
s1/s2 字段全部兜底 · forks 只含 prefilter
不调 laya / S2

div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AnalysisConfig.s1Type ?

div.style: color: rgb(74, 20, 140) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runS1SystemOne()
Laya 决策模型 · POST {baseUrl}/v1/systemone
state.chat{relationship:wechat_work,
conversation, messages:[[from,text]], latest_from}
+ state.background ← PromptStore 会话级提示词
题集一次批量 fan-out

div.style: color: rgb(74, 20, 140) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runS1Local()
端侧 MiniCPM4-0.5B-MNN
复用 openai 风格 prompt + 防御式解析
LiteRT 2.2.0 · LayaTfliteEngine

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S1 判定结果（防御式解析，字段缺失不崩）
need_action: noul → {value, prob}
importance: score 0-9
due_window: choice none/today/tomorrow/this_week/later
topic: choice work_task/schedule/notice/smalltalk/risk
confidence

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
forks += {fork:s1, prob:needActionProb,
verdict: needAction ? split : sharp,
note: s1.toInjectText()}
logcat tag = AgentTree

div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
s1.shouldEscalate() ?
need_action prob ≥ 0.5
或 importance ≥ 6
或 confidence < 0.5
任一命中即升级

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
结案：只保留 S1 结论
escalated = false

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
config.s2Enabled 且
s2Provider = local ?

div.style: color: rgb(74, 20, 140) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runS2Local()
端侧 MiniCPM3-4B-GGUF Q4_K_M

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
config.s2Slot() != null ?
（开关关闭或未配置则跳过）

div.style: color: rgb(74, 20, 140) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
runS2OpenAi()
POST {url}/chat/completions
S1 判定结论注入 S2 prompt
服务商：jev / glm / custom

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S2 深分析结果
summary · due_time
suggested_action · tasks[]
失败不拖垮 case：保留 S1，escalated=false

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AnalysisCaseRecord 落库
AnalysisStore → files/analysis.jsonl
含 forks 决策轨迹数组 + raw_json 原文

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
脱敏标记 RedactorCore.kt 250
RedactorRules ID_CARD/PHONE/NAME 等
CLOUD_REDACT 下产出 redacted=true

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

NONE / TODO / TRACK / DONE / NOISE

span.p:
needAction = true
且提醒开关开启？

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CalendarHelper.create
dedupKey = caseId
→ 三级降级提醒链

本轮结束 · recordResult 写状态文案
网络/HTTP 失败 → Result.retry()

AdvisorWorker（Fable 层）
通读近 7 天 case · ≤50 个 · 摘要截 30 字
调 System 2 服务商生成复盘
{summary, suggestions:[{type,title,detail}]}
type ∈ prompt/watchlist/threshold/other
